subject: Private Way Snow Removal and Maintenance Policies
overview: The committee discussed legal mechanisms and funding strategies for providing municipal services on private ways, which make up nearly 40% of Medford's roads. Members moved to advance a ballot question for 2027 regarding snow removal liability and requested legal guidance on establishing dedicated maintenance funds.

items.title: Ballot Question on Private Way Snow Removal Liability
items.summary: Referred to a future regular meeting a proposal to place Massachusetts General Law Chapter 40, Section 6C on the November 2027 ballot to allow the city to plow private ways without assuming full public way tort liability. The committee requested a formal legal opinion on how this adoption would impact the liability of both the city and private property owners during snow emergencies.

items.title: Routine Maintenance and Funding of Private Ways
items.summary: Kept in committee a resolution seeking a dedicated budget line item for private way repairs and the creation of a public FAQ website to clarify city policies on non-public roads. The committee requested legal advice on whether formalizing maintenance funding would create new liability risks for the city and planned a future meeting to design public education materials regarding private way ownership and services.
